definition.title: Highlighter Swipe
definition.desc: Four semantic key phrases receive irregular marker swipes when they become substantially visible in a local reading flow. Each phrase triggers once, then leaves observation until the sequence is replayed.
definition.seen: Seen on: manifestos, editorial essays, annotated case studies, and learning experiences
definition.hint: A marker swipes across the key phrase
definition.html:
NOTES ON INTERACTION / 07

The interface should remember the hand.

Useful movement begins with a simple promise: the surface will answer when someone acts upon it.

That answer does not need spectacle. Often the strongest response is small enough to feel inevitable, arriving exactly where attention already rests.

Motion can describe a relationship before language has time to explain it.

Timing matters because sequence matters. A transition should preserve the cause of change while revealing its result.

The final test is not novelty. It is whether the experience becomes easier to understand and trust.

FIELD NOTE 07 / END
Ship the part thatmatters most first.Then polish.
